## About
Alameda Imports is a used auto parts store on S Alameda St in Los Angeles. Customers come to us for everything from tail lights to engines.
Neighbors who have visited describe the people here as friendly and helpful, with fair prices. We hold a 4 star rating from 41 Google reviews.

## Services
- Quality used parts: Used auto parts for drivers across the Los Angeles area.
- Tail lights: Replacement tail lights, like the set one customer found for a Scion tC.

A: Yes. Our website lets you search our inventory, search by image, or run a multi-part search.
